name: Mediterranean Chickpea Sandwich with Sprouts, Tomato & Side Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce
3 tomatoes
1 ½ (3 oz) pkgs alfalfa sprouts

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with mayo, Dijon, and spices. Whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
¾ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas; add to the bowl with the mayo dressing. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash chickpeas until semi-smooth.
Roughly chop sun-dried tomatoes and olives. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
⅓ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the chickpea salad, and set aside.
Place oil, vinegar, and spices in another large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
½ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and roughly chop artichokes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Divide the chickpea salad between half of the slices and spread out in an even layer. Layer with tomato and sprouts, then close sandwiches with remaining slices of bread.
Slice sandwiches in half and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
